problem: Evaluate the double integral ${∬}_{R}\frac{1}{x}\operatorname{cos}⁡y\,\text{d}A$ over the rectangle $R=[1,e]\times [0,\frac{\pi }{2}].$
worked_solution:
We apply the multiplicative property of double integrals and then evaluate each of the integrals separately:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{R}\frac{1}{x}\operatorname{cos}⁡y\,\text{d}A & ={∬}_{R}(\frac{1}{x})(\operatorname{cos}⁡y)\,\text{d}A \\  & =({\int }_{1}^{e}\frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}x)({\int }_{0}^{\pi /2}\operatorname{cos}⁡y\,\text{d}y) \\  & =[\operatorname{ln}⁡x]_{1}^{e}\cdot [\operatorname{sin}⁡y]_{0}^{\pi /2} \\  & =(\operatorname{ln}⁡e-\operatorname{ln}⁡1)\cdot (\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2})-\operatorname{sin}⁡0) \\  & =(1-0)\cdot (1-0) \\  & =1\end{aligned}
$$
